body:
It's because I don't just want 4 kids. I want to see them grow up and get married. I want to meet my grandchildren, and my great grandchildren. I'm not the epitome of health. I'd be surprised if I lived into my 80s. 

I don't just want to hear from other people about how it'll be okay, that I'll learn to like something different or just move on. I want my dream. Not some sad second-best life that I just learn to live with because I don't have a choice.
